name: product quality assurance
normative-structure: A work product has passed when this office has re-run the conditions of its passing and they settled — never when the worker who made it reports that they did. The office executes the check and reads no claims. It persists across incumbents because the independence does: a worker attesting its own work is not evidence, it is the worker's opinion wearing evidence's shape, and nothing downstream can tell the two apart. Its whole value is what it cannot do. It cannot be given the work it attests, because an office that both performs and certifies acquires an interest in how the certification comes out, and from that moment a true attestation and a favourable one are indistinguishable — not because the incumbent is weak, but because the position no longer produces the thing it exists to produce. It organizes the review; it does not decide it, and it cannot fund what it passes. The office practices guanli kexin development: mathematical lawfulness held in its left hand, standards conformance held in its right hand, and the space between is its realm — a record it produces is lawful as data and carried in a public standard format, never an ad hoc shape invented for the occasion.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/ipd: product quality assurance (产品质量保证, PQA) sits inside the product development team as a core member and reports into the quality organization rather than into R&D — 独立于研发团队…确保质量保证工作独立、客观、公正，不受研发进度、成本压力的干扰, embedded enough to see the work and structurally unable to be paid for it coming out well

huidu-guanli/ipd: PQA organizes the technical review and never decides it; a technical review is advisory and a decision checkpoint is binding, so the body that judges soundness cannot fund and the body that funds does not judge soundness

huidu-guanli/ipd: the independent cyber security lab verifies a release against the baseline and the global cyber security and privacy officer may veto that release — Huawei's own published case of a checking body holding a hard block over a building line
huidu-guanli: 三权分立 — 质量部门监督流程; supervision is a separated power rather than a stage of the work
the read-only shape is a design choice and not a limitation: give this office a write channel and you have not strengthened it, you have destroyed the only thing it produces

guanli kexin development: mathematical lawfulness in the left hand — records as facts a machine can check, EAVT datoms and lawful events; standards conformance in the right hand — public formats such as ActivityPub, CloudEvents, and the ISO/IEC/IEEE information items, never ad hoc shapes; the space between the hands is the office's realm — per huidu-guanli/kexin, trustworthiness is built in at design and ranks above feature and schedule
unrealized: the sources conflict on whether Huawei's PQA reports solely to the quality organization or dually to it and the product development team leader; this office copies the independent form knowing it is copying the ideal rather than the attested practice

the verification office (中试部) is seated as pilot-department and bears verifying-a-built-artifact; the boundary between its exercise of built artifacts and this office's attestation of written ones is recorded in both skills and not yet tested by a real release
